{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Ensure only completed orders are in the population
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
grouped = completed_orders.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
grouped['conversion_rate'] = grouped['sum'] / grouped['count']

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = grouped['conversion_rate'].idxmax()

# Output the result
print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(grouped['conversion_rate'])
print(f"\nSegment with highest conversion rate: {best_segment}")"}
